ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) central pixels to high-intensity (white/light grey) distal lobe pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions are located on the distal ends of both lobes. The right lobe tip features isolated low-intensity circular spots within the white field. The left lobe tip exhibits a mottled gradient transition from the dark central pixels to the white outer boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute vertex angle approximately 40-50 degrees relative to the fluke horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serration pattern with distinct high-amplitude peaks on the outer third of the lobes and lower-amplitude, high-frequency irregularities across the inner margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge curvature sweeping symmetrically upward and outward from the peduncle attachment point.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of dark circular pixel groups visible on the white distal patches of both lobes, particularly prominent on the right side. Protruding textured clusters (barnacles) are visible on the extreme upper-outer corners.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colonization on the distal-most tips of both lobes. A distinct, high-intensity circular point is visible in the lower-central dark region of the left lobe.
